description: Chief agent invented fake email address (susie@oharafamily.com) instead of retrieving actual Susie O'Hara credentials from 1Password. This is a serious violation — never invent credentials.
root_cause: Agent attempted manual credential lookup via CLI commands instead of using 1Password MCP tool to retrieve the stored profile. When CLI failed, agent fabricated an email instead of requesting the correct tool.
correction: NEVER invent credentials. Always use 1Password MCP tool to retrieve stored profiles. For this task: Use 1Password UI integration in Chrome (cmd+\) to access Susie's saved profile, or use 1Password MCP read operation.
lesson: Invented credentials are worse than authentication failure — they cause silent wrong behavior. Always fail loudly or use the correct tool.
